what_is_already_solved: model-agnostic invariant learning with inferred temporal environments
what_is_not_solved: EV-specific support semantics, uncertainty validity, rejection and downstream risk
implication_for_ev_research: FOIL should be a baseline, not the novelty claim

what_is_already_solved: pattern-specific experts for patch-level distribution shifts
what_is_not_solved: unseen-station zero-shot support, calibrated entire-trajectory uncertainty
implication_for_ev_research: ordinary mixture-of-experts under drift is occupied

what_is_already_solved: finite-sample certificate-driven online residual calibration with gate-based reversion
what_is_not_solved: EV cross-city zero-shot deployment and operational abstention semantics
implication_for_ev_research: safe fallback must exceed generic gated residual correction

what_is_already_solved: covariate-shift correction and selection of reliable support-overlap regions
what_is_not_solved: sequential multi-horizon EV curves and station-level action/risk mapping
implication_for_ev_research: support-overlap is promising but cannot be copied without EV-specific temporal design

what_is_already_solved: simultaneous entire-path coverage for heterogeneous trajectories
what_is_not_solved: distribution support failure and charging dispatch costs
implication_for_ev_research: evaluate curve-level rather than 96 independent marginal intervals

what_is_already_solved: inference-time adaptation using examples from related series
what_is_not_solved: which charging stations are valid analogs and when no analog exists
implication_for_ev_research: retrieval/support selection is more promising than a generic foundation-model swap

what_is_already_solved: cross-site probabilistic transfer using two weeks of target data
what_is_not_solved: strict zero-shot, unlabeled adaptation, support-overlap diagnosis and abstention
implication_for_ev_research: few-shot transfer alone is not a sufficient novelty

what_is_already_solved: Tobit and censored-quantile graph models for simulated true latent demand under capacity/competition censoring
what_is_not_solved: identification from real operational data, multi-cause censoring, temporal policy changes and dispatch use
implication_for_ev_research: served power must not be equated with unconstrained demand

what_is_already_solved: traffic prediction converted to probabilistic charging load through queue/service models
what_is_not_solved: latent rejected demand with real station networks, spatial substitution and OOD uncertainty
implication_for_ev_research: queue modeling itself is not new; joint observed/latent/service forecasting may be

what_is_already_solved: real-pilot causal effect estimation for dynamic charging discounts
what_is_not_solved: portable action-conditioned forecasting across stations/policies and uncertainty under extrapolation
implication_for_ev_research: policy-conditioned forecasting is high-value but requires intervention data

what_is_already_solved: end-to-end feedback from RL charging decisions to a departure/session-duration forecaster
what_is_not_solved: multi-EV aggregate hard constraints, robust guarantees, calibrated scenarios and OOD
implication_for_ev_research: decision loss alone is occupied; robust learning-augmented dispatch is more distinct

what_is_already_solved: formal robustness, consistency and smoothness trade-offs with partial predictions
what_is_not_solved: EV network constraints and stochastic multi-horizon advice
implication_for_ev_research: offers a stronger theory target than average dispatch-cost improvement

what_is_already_solved: feedback-based conformal uncertainty for trajectory optimization
what_is_not_solved: charging-station-specific feasibility, prices, capacity and service guarantees
implication_for_ev_research: ordinary conformal-in-MPC integration is already adjacent prior art

what_is_already_solved: client clustering, heterogeneous local architectures and cross-model mutual distillation
what_is_not_solved: EV-specific OOD calibration, privacy attacks and decision risk
implication_for_ev_research: heterogeneous submodels alone cannot be the project novelty

what_is_already_solved: synthetic knowledge carriers for client consensus and global trajectory refinement
what_is_not_solved: formal privacy and EV domain shift/uncertainty guarantees
implication_for_ev_research: synthetic-data knowledge sharing is an occupied design pattern

what_is_already_solved: privacy-preserving score sketches and valid conformal calibration under joint client shift
what_is_not_solved: dependent multi-horizon time series and EV dispatch semantics
implication_for_ev_research: federated conformal alone is not novel; temporal and operational extension is required

what_is_already_solved: probabilistic reconciliation for mixed discrete and continuous hierarchies
what_is_not_solved: charging service physics and OOD station hierarchy
implication_for_ev_research: joint count/occupancy/energy coherence is possible but needs domain constraints beyond generic reconciliation

what_is_already_solved: confidence-dependent EV aggregate feasible-region representation for grid coordination
what_is_not_solved: data-driven finite-sample/OOD validity and real charging behavior
implication_for_ev_research: probabilistic flexibility boundary alone is occupied

what_is_already_solved: lightweight multi-horizon quantile forecasting, calibration diagnostics, split-conformal correction and asymmetric-cost evaluation on two EV datasets
what_is_not_solved: strict unseen-city/station OOD, support-domain diagnosis, abstention and full dispatch-risk guarantees
implication_for_ev_research: A new probability paper cannot rely on quantiles plus conformal and a cost metric alone; it must address unsupported domains and operational tail risk.

what_is_already_solved: leakage-free rolling-origin comparison of temporal, spatial and spatio-temporal models under consistent preprocessing
what_is_not_solved: strict cross-city/new-station OOD, calibrated uncertainty and decision-linked failure analysis
implication_for_ev_research: Protocol novelty and simple baselines are mandatory; spatial complexity cannot be assumed beneficial.

what_is_already_solved: joint stochastic modeling of arrivals, duration and power with compound Poisson/Cox processes for profile, daily energy and peak forecasting
what_is_not_solved: nonstationary behavior, congestion, unseen-station transfer and calibrated tail/exceedance guarantees
implication_for_ev_research: A point-process or event-generation model alone is prior art; novelty requires adaptation, support diagnostics or risk-aware downstream integration.

what_is_already_solved: session-energy forecasting, residual anomaly scoring and validation using real data plus injected digital-twin anomalies
what_is_not_solved: calibrated OOD forecast reliability, new-station transfer and causal distinction between anomalies and legitimate behavior shifts
implication_for_ev_research: Missingness/anomaly robustness should be an assurance module rather than the main forecasting novelty unless a stronger reliability guarantee is introduced.

what_is_already_solved: multi-year Scotland benchmark, station metadata/weather/spatial data and interpretable INLA uncertainty modeling
what_is_not_solved: strict full-network OOD protocol, tail-risk calibration and file-level energy/power semantics
implication_for_ev_research: Scotland is a strong additional temporal/regional holdout dataset and reduces dependence on six-month city benchmarks.

what_is_already_solved: fluid-queue forecasts that account for uncertain known/unforeseen arrivals and station capacity, then feed charging schedules
what_is_not_solved: real rejected-arrival/waiting labels, multi-station spatial substitution, calibration and strict OOD validation
implication_for_ev_research: Power-only forecasting misses service congestion, but a joint congestion direction is data-limited and must pass an identifiability gate.

what_is_already_solved: total-session-energy prediction from plug-in/early measurements and station-partitioned FL on ACN
what_is_not_solved: cross-operator/cross-site federation, calibrated uncertainty, control value and explicit privacy/cyber threat tests
implication_for_ev_research: Early-session prediction is an operational side task, not an untouched primary station day-ahead forecasting direction.

what_is_already_solved: adaptive transformation/test-time normalization for fat-tailed, drifting time series
what_is_not_solved: EV-specific peak-event labels, upper-tail calibration under station/city OOD and grid exceedance semantics
implication_for_ev_research: Tail modeling can strengthen the OOD main line, but generic fat-tail normalization is only a baseline.

what_is_already_solved: training masks that exclude uncertain/anomalous timesteps to reduce overfitting
what_is_not_solved: deployment-time reliability certification and distinction between rare valid peaks and corrupt observations
implication_for_ev_research: Blindly filtering charging peaks risks deleting the events most important to grid safety; data-quality modules require tail-aware audits.

what_is_already_solved: nonstationary diffusion with compound-Poisson jumps and a neural solver for abrupt time-series changes
what_is_not_solved: domain-specific exceedance probabilities, support-aware OOD and operational peak timing/value
implication_for_ev_research: Jump-process modeling is a possible backbone, not a standalone EV innovation.

what_is_already_solved: coverage characterization for split conformal with memory under stationary beta-mixing temporal dependence
what_is_not_solved: nonstationary EV domain shift, multihorizon peak risk and support failure
implication_for_ev_research: Conformal claims must distinguish temporal-dependence validity from cross-domain/OOD validity.

what_is_already_solved: lightweight winner-takes-all multihead forecasting of diverse multivariate futures
what_is_not_solved: EV service-flow coherence, tail coverage and decision-oriented scenario reduction
implication_for_ev_research: Generating several plausible load trajectories is already generic; EV work needs validity and operational semantics.

what_is_already_solved: programmable synthetic evaluation of temporal pattern learning, corruption robustness and theoretical optima
what_is_not_solved: EV-specific pattern taxonomy and mapping from synthetic failures to real deployment risk
implication_for_ev_research: A controlled capability audit should precede architecture selection and can reveal whether complex models learn the required charging patterns.

what_is_already_solved: diffusion-guided conformity scores with online recalibration under temporal/covariate shift
what_is_not_solved: EV support-domain interpretation, selective service commitments, peak-trajectory coverage and dispatch fallback
implication_for_ev_research: Adaptive conformal under shift is crowded; EV novelty must be problem- and risk-specific.
